inlines.v: DIRT, n durt. 1. Any foul or filthy substance; excrement; earth; mud; mire; dust; whatever adhering to any thing, renders it foul or unclean. The fat closed, and the dirt came out. Judges 3:22. Whose waters cast up mire and dirt Isaiah 57:20. 2. Meanness; sordidness. [Not in use.] DIRT, verb transitive durt. To make foul or filthy; to soil; to bedaub; to pollute; to defile.
